hotels.vendor_name: Grand Mercure Rio de Janeiro Copacabana
hotels.title: Beachfront Rio de Janeiro Retreat Overlooking Copacabana Beach with Restaurant, Rooftop Bar & Pool
hotels.description: Overlooking the famed Copacabana Beach, Grand Mercure Rio de Janeiro Copacabana offers a vibrant base in one of the city's most iconic neighbourhoods. Spend days lazing on the golden sands just steps from the lobby or soak up Rio de Janeiro's infectious energy at lively cafes, vibrant bars and colourful street markets. When you're ready to rest, the hotel offers a chic escape. Soak up sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and Sugarloaf Mountain from the sophisticated rooftop bar or refresh with a dip in the sparkling infinity pool. On the second floor, Caza Alimo restaurant serves authentic Brazilian fare alongside local wine and hand-crafted cocktails throughout the day.
